# Docs Update

## Change Summary

Added `docs/UNITS.md` as the canonical unit and display policy for chemistry-facing data. The new doc fixes the bead’s design decisions in writing: internal authoritative chemistry stays whole-tank total based, per-liter values are derived or input-only, helper and snapshot/API names must carry their element basis, scientific display (`mg N/L`, `mg P/L`, `mg C/L`) is the default public contract, ion-style display is opt-in and presentation-only, and TDS/conductivity must be labeled as estimates. I also linked the new policy from `README.md` and `docs/scientific_inventory.md`, then closed bead `tanksim-6e5.2.1`.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspected current water-state, snapshot, source-water, process-parameter, API, TUI, and scientific-inventory files to ground the policy in existing unit semantics and naming mismatches.
1. [Completed] Created `docs/UNITS.md` with the internal storage policy, helper naming rules, display policy, TDS/conductivity estimation labels, type-safety roadmap, and downstream migration targets; linked it from `README.md` and `docs/scientific_inventory.md`.
2. [Completed] Validated the docs/backlog update by closing the bead, running backlog lint, and checking the diff for whitespace issues.

## Validation Evidence

- `br show tanksim-6e5.2.1` matched the prompt context and acceptance criteria before editing.
- Inspected `crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/source_water.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs`, `crates/tank_api/src/handlers/snapshot.rs`, and `crates/tank_tui/src/screens/chemistry.rs` to align the policy with current total-based storage and display naming.
- `br close tanksim-6e5.2.1 --reason="Completed"` succeeded and updated `.beads/issues.jsonl`.
- `br lint` passed with `No template warnings found (58 issues checked)`.
- `git diff --check` returned no whitespace or patch-format problems.

## Outstanding Risks

- Runtime code still exposes the old ambiguous chemistry field names in snapshots, API payloads, and the TUI; this stage documents the target contract but does not implement those renames.
- Future serialized-field renames will need explicit migration handling (`serde` aliases or a schema-version bump) so save/load compatibility does not break silently.
- The documented ion-style display toggle and estimated TDS/conductivity relabeling are policy only for now; downstream implementation work is still required in `tanksim-6e5.2.7` and related UI/API beads.
